summary: Fresh independent full canonical chronology audit of Jiuwudaishi 009 after the sealed two-group repair. All 159 Chinese units, 1,438 temporal and active-date-hint checks, and 154 people were re-read against the revised extraction. Regnal chronology remains Zhenming 3 = AD 917, 4 = AD 918, and 5 = AD 919. The recalled 劉鄩失律 is correctly only on or before AD 917; the retrospective 初 anecdote about Dou Mengzheng and Qian Liu is correctly only on or before AD 918. No unsupported lower endpoint, event-owner, reception, omitted life-date, conversion, active-hint, translation, or temporal-geometry defect remains.
